data.name: Clara Wraiths
data.detailed_description:
Clara Wraiths is a 2D top-down survival horror game based on the story of a psychic, called Clara, who investigates the various haunted locations in the US in order to help out the spirits to move on or find peace.

Clara, the psychic, reached a family in Texas who desperately needed help with the increasing paranormal activities in their home. The home was built in the 1980s in Texas and is now owned by Mr. Henry. He lives along with three other family members in that haunted house, and recently, they have been experiencing paranormal activities in their house at a level that they have never seen before. It started a few days after Henry's mother passed away, and he is really concerned about his family's safety because of the poltergeist activities taking place in their home, which include moving furniture, disembodied voices and laughs, dark apparitions, etc. He even heard weird growling noises coming from the basement area frequently.

For this reason, Henry got in touch with Clara, the psychic medium, to visit their home and provide them with the answers and possible solutions to the problem. Clara is very much capable of helping out the spirits to move on or find peace, and this might help ease the paranormal activities in the house.

You play as Clara, a psychic, and your mission is to help out the family and help trapped spirits of the house to move on. Will you be able to succeed in this mission?

Key Features:

  • Explore the entire haunted house in Texas!
  • Come face-to-face with the spirits!
  • Collect items like keys, golden ring etc.
  • Avoid traps like spikes, fire etc.
  • Explore the unknown spirit world!
  • Help out the good spirits to crossover!
  • Nearly half an hour of paranormal investigation!

Warning:

This game contains flashing lights which may not be suitable for people with epilepsy or other photosensitive conditions. Player discretion is advised.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 11
  • Processor: Dual Core 1 Ghz or higher
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 128 MB of Video Memory, Capable of Shader Model 2.0+
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 50 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any Compatible Sound Card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 11
  • Processor: Dual Core 2Ghz or higher
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 256 MB of Video Memory, Capable of Shader Model 2.0+
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 50 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any Compatible Sound Card
